in three steps.

Start with a clear idea, choose your media and refine one detail at a time. A small experiment can become the opening of a longer project.

Answers before
you create.

Is YVD AI free?

Sign in to claim 10 daily credits. Return after each 24-hour wait to claim the next daily reward. Promotional credits expire 24 hours after each grant; missed days do not accumulate. Images, videos and music share your account balance. Review the quote before generating. Memberships have their own listed daily allowance.

Why is it free?

Choose a free account, membership or credit top-up. The model quote shows the credits needed for your creation.

Can I use YVD AI to make YouTube Shorts?

Yes. Sign in before generating a video, then choose Video and a 9:16 aspect ratio to create a vertical clip, then download the result for your edit. Our templates help with the visual starting point. Add your own narration, captions, music and final cuts in your editing software before uploading a complete YouTube Short.

Can I use YVD AI for ads or commercial work?

You can explore product scenes and advertising concepts here. Before publishing commercially, review the selected model’s terms and the rights to your reference images, likenesses, logos and soundtrack. Generated scenes need human review, and this studio does not guarantee clearance, factual product claims or a particular advertising result.

Can I use my own footage or images in YVD?

Upload PNG, JPEG or WebP images, and add MP4 or WebM video and MP3 or WAV audio when the selected model supports them. Reference counts, first and last frames, duration and output controls follow the model. Use the reference panel to assign inputs, and upload only media you have permission to use.

What happens if my generation fails?

Confirmed failed generations return the credits used, with the original grant expiry. Your creation records stay in your account; provider media links can expire, so download finished files you want to keep.

Set the scene. Let the camera move.

Start a sceneworth exploring.

Bring atmosphere, movement and a clear subject to your next film. Explore cinematic AI video with Grok Imagine, Kling, Seedance or another model in the studio. Each example starts with a reusable prompt; open it, change the direction and make a new scene of your own.

Try this prompt

Drifting in blue

A few translucent forms, a little light and a steady camera. Keep the motion delicate for a quiet underwater film.

After the rain

Follow a red tram through warm city streets. Reflections and a single tracking move give a travel scene its own rhythm.

A paper moon

Build a handmade world around an original character. Describe the materials as carefully as the action for a tactile animated scene.

Lines in the sand

Small silhouettes against a vast landscape create an immediate sense of scale. Keep the camera smooth and the desert light warm.

Made by hand

Give a craft film one precise action. A glowing material, a focused pair of hands and close framing can carry the entire scene.

A vertical frame, a fresh direction.

Small stories.A reason to keep watching.

Build a vertical short around a nature moment, original character or cinematic opening. These editable AI video templates give you a starting point for your own story.

Winter wings

Start a nature short with a recognizable subject and a gentle reveal. Fine feather detail and soft snowfall make the frame feel inviting.

Light after dark

Use a reflection to make a vertical landscape feel expansive. Let the sky move slowly while the cabin gives viewers a point of focus.

Inside the wave

Keep the camera close to the action for a short sports edit. One clear turn and bright water create a strong opening beat.

A quieter route

A moving sail and a trail across still water tell a compact travel story. Adapt the weather, location and camera angle to your brief.

Room to grow

An original little robot adds character to a social clip. Choose one expressive action, a playful palette and a simple setting for the story.

Explore the look of your next launch

Find an anglefor your next campaign.

Explore AI UGC scenes and product video concepts before you plan a shoot. Describe a natural setting, a believable action and the atmosphere you want. These are generated creative examples, not real customer reviews, endorsements or footage of your product.

Sound in silhouette

Show the shape and finish before adding a sales message. A controlled orbit and a warm light accent give this audio product room to stand out.

Soft by design

Explore a beauty campaign with a restrained palette and tactile materials. Change the container, flower or surface to match a product concept.

A fresh step

A bold product silhouette makes a useful opening shot for a vertical ad. Describe fabric, color and lighting before choosing the movement.

A little refreshment

Pair a simple can with fresh ingredients and a splash of movement. Leave space in your final edit for the message and brand assets.

Space to settle

Bring a home design idea to life with a slow camera move and soft light. Small environmental details can give a room a calm, lived-in atmosphere.

Your first YVD AI creation,in three steps.

Start with a clear idea, choose your media and refine one detail at a time. A small experiment can become the opening of a longer project.

  1. 01Choose your starting pointSelect a template to load its prompt, model and settings. Adjust the draft before generating; selecting a template never submits a request.
  2. 02Describe what should happenDescribe the subject, setting and style. For video, add one action and camera movement. A reference image can guide the look. See how to write a video prompt for examples you can adapt.
  3. 03Generate, review and downloadSign in to create images, videos and music with your daily credits. Preview and download the result, then return through your history or reuse the prompt.

Is YVD AI free?

Sign in to claim 10 daily credits. Return after each 24-hour wait to claim the next daily reward. Promotional credits expire 24 hours after each grant; missed days do not accumulate. Images, videos and music share your account balance. Review the quote before generating. Memberships have their own listed daily allowance.

Why is it free?

Choose a free account, membership or credit top-up. The model quote shows the credits needed for your creation.

Can I use YVD AI to make YouTube Shorts?

是的。 Sign in before generating a video, then choose Video and a 9:16 aspect ratio to create a vertical clip, then download the result for your edit. Our templates help with the visual starting point. Add your own narration, captions, music and final cuts in your editing software before uploading a complete YouTube Short.

Can I use YVD AI for ads or commercial work?

You can explore product scenes and advertising concepts here. Before publishing commercially, review the selected model’s terms and the rights to your reference images, likenesses, logos and soundtrack. Generated scenes need human review, and this studio does not guarantee clearance, factual product claims or a particular advertising result.

Can I use my own footage or images in YVD?

Upload PNG, JPEG or WebP images, and add MP4 or WebM video and MP3 or WAV audio when the selected model supports them. Reference counts, first and last frames, duration and output controls follow the model. Use the reference panel to assign inputs, and upload only media you have permission to use.

What happens if my generation fails?

Confirmed failed generations return the credits used, with the original grant expiry. Your creation records stay in your account; provider media links can expire, so download finished files you want to keep.
